verdict: No paid spend or leads were recorded in the last 28 days across Meta and Google Ads, so organic channels are carrying all engagement. performance.verdict: Organic is collapsing and overdue deliverables are blocking the stay/walk decision.

findings.text: Dashboard not live by Aug 31 deadline; 104 GHL opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments logged — scoreboard is unreadable.
Phone-match attribution gap (due Aug 7) and sync/contact cleanup (due Aug 14) both overdue; renewal decision depends on trusted attribution that does not yet exist.
SC clicks fell 70.83% week-over-week; 3-day signal confirms: Aug 31–Sep 2 averaged 1.3 clicks/day vs 1.7 prior 3 days — trend is flat-to-declining, not recovering.
GBP actions dropped 40% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 30–Sep 2) recorded 0 actions vs a prior-3-day average of 10.3 — a confirmed 3-day signal, not noise.
Zero paid spend across all 28 days on Meta and Google; $0 CPL is meaningless — no paid channel is contributing any leads to the August scoreboard.

suggestions.text: Ship the GHL dashboard immediately; 104 open opps and 0 won means the scoreboard is dark — renewal decision is Sept.
suggestions.monday_update: The client dashboard must go live now: 104 GHL opportunities exist with 0 won and 0 appointments recorded, making the August scoreboard unreadable. Both the attribution gap (due Aug 7) and sync/contact cleanup (due Aug 14) are also overdue and are blocking trusted lead-to-patient tracking. Success check: dashboard accessible to Sohib and Dr. Jamal by 2026-09-06, showing lead → scheduled → shown → new patient counts. If not live by then, the renewal decision is made blind.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP 0-action streak (Aug 30–Sep 2) and SC -70.83% drop — both organic lifelines are failing simultaneously.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP recorded 0 actions on Aug 30, 31, and Sep 1–2 after averaging 10.3 actions/day in the prior 3 days; Search Console clicks dropped 70.83% week-over-week. These are the only active channels with $0 paid spend across the full 28-day window. Investigate GBP listing status, any suspension flags, and whether a technical SEO issue (index drop, crawl error) explains the SC collapse. Success check: root cause identified and corrected by 2026-09-06; GBP actions resume above 5/day within 3 days of fix.

suggestions.text: Watch whether paid reactivation is authorized; $0 spend for 28 days means no paid data to act on — do not scale blind.
suggestions.monday_update: No Meta or Google spend has run in 28 days, so there is no CPL baseline or campaign data to justify a budget move this cycle. Per the 7/19 call, budget shifts were directed mainly toward Google/LSA — confirm with Sohib whether paid activation is in scope for September. Do not launch or scale any paid channel until the attribution and dashboard fixes (S1) are in place, or leads will arrive with no trackable path. Re-check 2026-09-06 after SOW deliverables are resolved.
